ui.lib.game.chessNote: Ukina n'umweru kandi ni wowe utangira. Kanda ku gice cyawe, hanyuma ku kazu ushaka kujyamo. Inzirakarengane igeze ku murongo wa nyuma iba umwamikazi. Tsinda ukora mate umukara.

ui.lib.game.xqNote: Ukina n'umutuku (hasi) kandi ni wowe utangira. Kanda ku gice cyawe, hanyuma ku ngingo ushaka kujyaho. Abajenerali bombi ntibashobora guhagarara bareba mu maso; mate cyangwa kutagira urugendo rwemewe bisobanura gutsindwa.
ui.lib.game.goNote: Ikibaho cya {n}×{n}. Ukina n'umukara kandi ni wowe utangira. Amanota abarwa hakurikijwe ubuso (amabuye + ingingo zirimo ubusa zikikijwe burundu); umweru ubona komi {k}. Fata amabuye yose y'uwo muhanganye yapfuye mbere yo gusimbuka. Kwiyahura no gufata ako kanya (ko) ntibyemewe. Umukino urangira abakinnyi bombi basimbutse ikurikiranye.

ui.lib.game.aiPassed: Mudasobwa yasimbutse. Nawe usimbutse, umukino urarangira hakabarwa amanota.
ui.lib.game.mmAsk: Ni iyihe tile yariho iri shusho?
ui.lib.game.mmNote: Kanda Tangira: tile ziragaragazwa amasegonda {s}, hanyuma zigahishwa. Wibuke ishusho n'ibara bya buri tile, hanyuma uhitemo tile ihuye n'ishusho yerekanwe. Amakosa arenze {l} atuma urwego rudatsinda.

ui.lib.online.modesHint: Ameza rusange agaragara ku rutonde kandi umuntu wese ashobora kwinjira. Ameza bwite agerwaho gusa n'ihuza ry'ubutumire.
ui.lib.online.noTables: Nta meza ategereje kugeza ubu. Kanda "Shaka uwo muhangana" cyangwa ufungure ameza mashya.
ui.lib.online.privacy: Ibikorwa binyura kuri seriveri ya MQTT rusange y'ubuntu kandi bihishwa kuri buri meza; seriveri ntibika imikino. Injira ukoresheje Google kugira ngo ubike imikino yarangiye muri Drive yawe.
ui.lib.online.waitingPublic: Ameza rusange: dutegereje ko hari uwinjira…
ui.lib.online.waitingPrivate: Ameza bwite: ohereza iri huza inshuti yawe. Umukino uratangira nirifungura.
ui.lib.online.full: Aya meza asanzwe afite abakinnyi 2. Shaka andi meza cyangwa ufungure mashya.
ui.lib.online.againAccept: Uwo muhanganye ashaka kwihorera — Ongera ukine
ui.lib.online.saved: Umukino wabitswe muri Google Drive (ububiko WFTools/Games).
ui.lib.online.saveFail: Umukino ntiwashoboye kubikwa muri Drive kugeza ubu.
ui.lib.game.darkNote: Xiangqi ihishe (Cờ úp): abajenerali bombi batangira bagaragara, ibindi bice bivangwa bigashyirwa byubitse. Igice gihishe kigenda nk'igice gisanzwe gitangirira ku kazu kacyo (ku kazu k'igare kigenda nk'igare), hanyuma kigahindurwa, kuva icyo gihe kikagenda nk'igice cyacyo nyacyo. Abajyanama n'inzovu bashobora kugenda ku kibaho cyose. Gutsindwa burundu cyangwa kubura icyo wakina bivuze gutsindwa.
ui.lib.online.pickTable: Shaka uwo muhangana cyangwa ufungure ameza mu gice cy'uruhande kugira ngo utangire.

home.title: WFTools — Ibikoresho bya interineti by'ubuntu
home.metaDescription: Ibikoresho bya interineti by'ubuntu: gukora QR n'barcode, gufunga no guhindura amashusho, guhuza/kugabanya PDF, guhindura JSON/XML/CSV/Excel, umushahara, inguzanyo, BMI, ingengabihe, kubara iminsi isigaye n'ibindi. Bikora muri browser yawe, nta kwiyandikisha.
home.lead: Hitamo igikoresho ukoreshe muri browser yawe. Nta kwiyandikisha, kandi amakuru yawe ntasohoka ku gikoresho cyawe.
home.keywords: ibikoresho bya interineti, ibikoresho by'ubuntu, gukora QR code, gukora barcode, gufunga amashusho, ibikoresho bya PDF, guhindura amadosiye, kubara umushahara, BMI, ibikoresho bya web

image.name: Ibikoresho by'amashusho
image.desc: Funga, uhindure, ukureho inyuma kandi ushyireho ikimenyetso ku mashusho ku gikoresho cyawe.

file.name: Ibikoresho by'amadosiye
file.desc: Huza/ugabanye PDF, uhindure PowerPoint, ugereranye inyandiko kandi uhindure amakuru.

business.name: Ubucuruzi bwa interineti
business.desc: Ibikoresho by'amaduka yo kuri interineti, ubucuruzi buto n'abakora ku giti cyabo.

finance.name: Imari n'ibikoresho byo kubara
finance.desc: Imibare nyayo ikurikije imirongo n'amabwiriza agezweho.

marketing.name: Kwamamaza
marketing.desc: QR code, amahuza y'ibikorwa byo kwamamaza n'amabara y'ikirango.

health.name: Ubuzima
health.desc: Kurikirana ibiro, imirire, amazi, imyitozo n'imihango.

edu.name: Uburezi n'Kwigisha
edu.desc: Ingengabihe, ibibazo, kuboneka mu ishuri, ibishushanyo by'ibitekerezo n'umushahara.

time.name: Ibikoresho by'igihe
time.desc: Amasaha, kubara iminsi isigaye, amasaha y'ibihugu, iminsi y'akazi n'ikayi y'ibyabaye.

dev.name: Ibikoresho by'abategura porogaramu
dev.desc: Tunganya, ugenzure, uhishe kandi uhindure kode.

text.name: Ibikoresho by'inyandiko
text.desc: Hindura inyuguti nkuru/ntoya, inyuguti z'ubwiza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, guhindura inyandiko mu ijwi no kwandika uvuga.

calc.name: Ibikoresho byo kubara no guhindura
calc.desc: Kalkulatrisi y'ubumenyi, ijanisha no guhindura ibipimo.

device.name: Isuzuma ry'ibikoresho
device.desc: Gerageza kamera yawe, wandike ecran, upime umuvuduko wo kwandika n'inshuro ukanda ku isegonda.

media.name: Amajwi na videwo
media.desc: Funga videwo, ukuremo amajwi ya MP3 kandi uhindure gitari yawe muri browser.

excel.name: Gutunganya amakuru ya Excel
excel.desc: Uzuza Word uvanye muri Excel, uhuze udusanduku, ushyire imirongo hejuru y'indi, kandi uhuze impapuro nyinshi cyangwa amadosiye ya Excel ukoresheje formula.

entertainment.name: Imyidagaduro n'imikino
entertainment.desc: Uruziga rw'amahirwe, kubona imibare ku bw'amahirwe, gutombora ibihembo n'imikino ishimishije.

image-convert.name: Funga ishusho
image-convert.desc: Gabanya ubunini bw'ishusho kandi ugabanye amashusho menshi icyarimwe kugira ngo yoherezwe vuba kuri interineti no kuri email.

image-format.name: Hindura ubwoko bw'ishusho
image-format.desc: Hindura amashusho hagati ya JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP na ICO (favicon) ku mbuga za web, porogaramu cyangwa kubika.

image-base64.name: Ishusho ihinduke Base64
image-base64.desc: Hindura amashusho ube inyandiko za Base64 ushyire muri HTML, CSS cyangwa kode, kandi usubize Base64 mu ishusho.

bg-remove.name: Kuraho inyuma y'ishusho
bg-remove.desc: Kuraho inyuma y'umweru cyangwa y'ibara rimwe ku mafoto y'ibicuruzwa, ibirango n'amafoto y'umwirondoro, ako kanya ku gikoresho cyawe.

watermark.name: Shyira ikimenyetso ku mashusho
watermark.desc: Shyira inyandiko, ikirango cyangwa ikimenyetso cy'uburenganzira ku shusho imwe cyangwa nyinshi icyarimwe.

pdf-merge.name: Huza & ugabanye PDF
pdf-merge.desc: Huza amadosiye menshi ya PDF ube umwe, ukuremo impapuro ukeneye, cyangwa ugabanye PDF urupapuro ku rundi.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF
pptx-pdf.desc: Hindura slide za PowerPoint (.pptx) ube PDF kandi uhindure amadosiye ya PDF ube PowerPoint.

file-diff.name: Gereranya amadosiye abiri
file-diff.desc: Shaka itandukaniro hagati y'inyandiko ebyiri: TXT, Word, HTML cyangwa PDF ifite inyandiko. Ibyongeweho, ibyakuweho n'ibyahindutse biragaragazwa.

text-analysis.name: Isesengura ry'inyandiko
text-analysis.desc: Bara amagambo, inyuguti, interuro n'ibika, ubare igihe cyo gusoma n'ubwinshi bw'ijambo ry'ingenzi mu nyandiko, TXT, Word cyangwa PDF.

data-convert.name: Hindura JSON, XML, CSV, Excel
data-convert.desc: Hindura amakuru hagati ya JSON, XML, CSV na Excel (.xlsx) ugaragarizwa mbere imbonerahamwe.

bmi-bmr.name: Kubara BMI na BMR
bmi-bmr.desc: Bara umubyibuho (BMI), igipimo cy'inda n'ikibuno, n'ibyo umubiri ukeneye by'ingufu (BMR, TDEE) hakurikijwe imyaka, igitsina n'urwego rw'imyitozo.

meal-calo.name: Gahunda y'amafunguro n'ingufu bya buri munsi
meal-calo.desc: Tegura amafunguro ukurikije intego y'ingufu, urebe ingufu z'ibiribwa bisanzwe kandi uringanize poroteyine, ibinyamasukari n'ibinure.

water-tracker.name: Gukurikirana amazi unywa
water-tracker.desc: Shyiraho intego ya buri munsi maze wandike amazi unywa, ugaragarizwa aho ugeze n'amateka y'iminsi myinshi.

calo-burn.name: Ingufu zikoreshwa mu myitozo
calo-burn.desc: Ubare ingufu zikoreshwa ukurikije siporo, igikorwa, igihe n'ibiro by'umubiri ukoresheje agaciro ka MET.

cycle-track.name: Gukurikirana imihango y'abagore
cycle-track.desc: Andika kandi uteganye imihango, umunsi w'irekurwa ry'intanga n'igihe cyo gusama. Amakuru agume ku gikoresho cyawe gusa.

study-timetable.name: Ingengabihe yo kwiga
study-timetable.desc: Kora ingengabihe y'amasomo y'icyumweru ukurikije amasaha; uyisohore cyangwa uyibike ngo uyikoreshe buri munsi.

quiz-bank.name: Ibibazo n'ububiko bw'ibibazo
quiz-bank.desc: Kora ububiko bw'ibibazo by'amahitamo menshi, uvange ibibazo, ukore ikizamini cyo kwitoza gihabwa amanota, kandi usohore ikizamini n'ibisubizo.

attendance.name: Kuboneka mu ishuri
attendance.desc: Kora urutonde rw'abanyeshuri, wandike abahari buri isomo kandi ukurikirane abadahari n'abatinze. Bishobora guhuzwa na Google Sheets.

mindmap.name: Igishushanyo cy'ibitekerezo n'incamake
mindmap.desc: Shushanya ibitekerezo by'amasomo kandi ukore incamake y'inyandiko ndende mu ngingo z'ingenzi mu buryo bwikora.

teaching-pay.name: Amasaha yo kwigisha n'ubwishyu
teaching-pay.desc: Andika amasomo wigishije, ubare amasaha yose n'ubwishyu ukurikije igiciro, kandi usohore raporo.

fullscreen-clock.name: Isaha ifata ecran yose
fullscreen-clock.desc: Isaha nini ya digitale ifata ecran yose, ifite chronomètre no kubara iminsi isigaye, amabara n'inyuguti bihinduka, n'imiterere y'amasaha 12/24.

countdown-video.name: Gukora videwo yo kubara asubira inyuma
countdown-video.desc: Kora ikibara-gihe gisubira inyuma gihindurwa uko ushaka maze ugikuremo nka videwo uyishyire muri videwo zawe.

world-clock.name: Isaha y'isi
world-clock.desc: Reba igihe kiriho mu bihugu byinshi icyarimwe kandi ugereranye itandukaniro ry'amasaha hagati yabyo.

workdays.name: Kubara iminsi y'akazi
workdays.desc: Bara iminsi y'akazi hagati y'amatariki abiri, usibye ku wa gatandatu, ku cyumweru n'iminsi mikuru.

journal.name: Ikayi y'ibyabaye kuri interineti
journal.desc: Andika ikayi ya buri munsi ibikwa mu ibanga muri Google Sheet yawe bwite, wowe wenyine ushobora kuyisoma.

code-format.name: Tunganya JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Tunganya neza kandi utondeke kode ya JavaScript, HTML, CSS na JSON.

code-check.name: Kugenzura imiterere ya kode
code-check.desc: Shaka amakosa y'imiterere muri JavaScript, HTML, CSS na JSON, hamwe n'umurongo n'inkingi.

js-obfuscate.name: Guhisha kode ya JavaScript
js-obfuscate.desc: Hindura inyandiko, uhindure amazina ya variable kandi uhishe JavaScript kugira ngo igorane gusomwa no gukopororwa.

rsa-keys.name: Imfunguzo za RSA no gufunga amakuru
rsa-keys.desc: Kora imfunguzo ebyiri za RSA (PEM), ufunge inyandiko ukoresheje urufunguzo rusange kandi uyifungure ukoresheje urufunguzo rwihariye, byose ku gikoresho cyawe.

text-to-html.name: Inyandiko itunganyijwe ihinduke HTML
text-to-html.desc: Hindura uko ubibona ukoresheje inyuguti zijimye, imitwe, ibitonde, imbonerahamwe n'amahuza, ubone kode ya HTML isukuye.

inventory.name: Ububiko n'ibiciro
inventory.desc: Shyiraho ibiciro byo kugurisha ukurikije amafaranga y'isoko, amatangazo n'inyungu. Kurikirana ibyinjira n'ibisohoka mu bubiko ukamenyeshwa ibigiye gushira.

invoice.name: Fagitire n'igiciro
invoice.desc: Kora ibiciro na fagitire z'ibyagurishijwe zifite ikirango, igiteranyo cyikora n'umubare mu magambo. Zisohore cyangwa uzibike nka PDF.

menu-qr.name: Menu ya QR
menu-qr.desc: Kora menu ya digitale ya resitora na kafe. Abakiriya basikana QR code kugira ngo babone amafunguro n'ibiciro.

barcode.name: Gukora barcode
barcode.desc: Kora barcode za Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A na Code 39 ku bimenyetso by'ibicuruzwa n'iby'ububiko.

loan.name: Kubara inguzanyo
loan.desc: Amafaranga yishyurwa buri kwezi, inyungu yose n'ingengabihe yo kwishyura ku nguzanyo y'inzu, imodoka n'iy'ibikoreshwa bya buri munsi.

compound.name: Inyungu y'inyongera n'ubwizigame
compound.desc: Teganya amafaranga uzabona ubitse cyangwa ushora buri kwezi ku buryo buhoraho.

salary.name: Umushahara mbumbe ↔ nyirizina
salary.desc: Hindura umushahara mbumbe (Gross) ube nyirizina (Net) no ku rundi ruhande, hakurikijwe amategeko y'ubwishingizi n'umusoro ku musaruro w'umuntu ku giti cye ya 2026 (Vietnam).

qr-code.name: Gukora QR Code
qr-code.desc: Kora QR code z'amahuza, inyandiko, Wi-Fi, email na nimero za telefone. Zikure nka PNG cyangwa SVG.

utm.name: Gukora ihuza rya UTM
utm.desc: Ongera ku mahuza kode zikurikirana ibikorwa byo kwamamaza kugira ngo umenye aho abasura baturuka.

colors.name: Amabara n'amakode yayo
colors.desc: Kora urutonde rw'amabara ahuje uhereye ku ibara ry'ibanze, ubone amakode ya HEX, RGB, HSL na variable za CSS.

expense.name: Amafaranga yinjiye n'asohotse
expense.desc: Andika amafaranga yinjiye n'asohotse buri munsi, urebe ikoreshwa ukurikije ibyiciro kandi ushyireho imbibi kugira ngo ugume ku ngengo y'imari.

habit.name: Gukurikirana imigirire n'iminsi ikurikiranye
habit.desc: Shyiraho ikimenyetso ku migirire buri munsi kandi ukurikirane iminsi ikurikiranye kugira ngo ugire ikinyabupfura.

cv.name: Gukora CV
cv.desc: Uzuza icyitegererezo ubona uko kimeze, uhitemo imiterere n'ibara, maze usohore cyangwa ubike nka PDF ku buntu.

currency-time.name: Ifaranga n'amasaha y'ibihugu
currency-time.desc: Hindura amafaranga ukurikije igiciro cya vuba kandi urebe igihe mu migi yo hirya no hino ku isi.

image-resize.name: Guhindura ingano y'ishusho
image-resize.desc: Hindura ingano y'amashusho ukurikije pikiseli cyangwa ijanisha, ubike igipimo kandi utunganye amashusho menshi icyarimwe.

image-crop.name: Gukata ishusho
image-crop.desc: Kata amashusho uko ushaka cyangwa kuri 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 na 9:16, kandi uzenguruke cyangwa uhindukize mbere yo gukuramo.

image-ocr.name: Ishusho ihinduke inyandiko (OCR)
image-ocr.desc: Kuramo inyandiko mu mafoto, amafoto ya ecran n'inyandiko zafotowe. Ishyigikira Icyongereza n'izindi ndimi zirenga 30.

heic-jpg.name: HEIC ihinduke JPG
heic-jpg.desc: Hindura amafoto ya HEIC yo kuri iPhone ube JPG cyangwa PNG kugira ngo afunguke ahantu hose. Guhindura menshi icyarimwe birashoboka.

image-upscale.name: Kwagura amashusho hakoreshejwe AI
image-upscale.desc: Agura amashusho 2× cyangwa 4× kandi usobanure utuntu twayo na AI. Ikwiye amafoto mato, atagaragara neza cyangwa ashaje.

image-to-pdf.name: Ishusho ihinduke PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Huza amashusho ya JPG na PNG muri PDF imwe, uhindure uko impapuro zikurikirana kandi uhitemo ingano y'impapuro n'impande.

pdf-to-image.name: PDF ihinduke ishusho
pdf-to-image.desc: Hindura buri rupapuro rwa PDF ruba JPG cyangwa PNG isobanutse, uhitemo ubuziranenge, ukure amashusho ku yindi cyangwa ZIP.

pdf-compress.name: Gufunga PDF
pdf-compress.desc: Gabanya ingano ya PDF kuri email no ku mpapuro zo kuri interineti. Hitamo urwego rwo gufunga kandi ugereranye ingano.

pdf-to-word.name: PDF ihinduke Word
pdf-to-word.desc: Hindura PDF ibe idosiye ya Word (.docx) ihindurwa ibika inyandiko n'ibika, cyangwa ubike imiterere y'urupapuro nk'amashusho.

word-to-pdf.name: Word ihinduke PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: Hindura amadosiye ya Word (.docx) ube PDF muri browser yawe, urebe mbere, hanyuma ukure cyangwa usohore.

pdf-sign.name: Gusinya PDF
pdf-sign.desc: Shushanya cyangwa wandike umukono wawe, wongereho umukono w'ishusho n'itariki, ubishyire ku mpapuro za PDF maze ukure.

pdf-edit.name: Guhindura PDF & kuzuza impapuro
pdf-edit.desc: Ongera inyandiko, ibimenyetso by'ukuri n'udusanduku two guhisha muri PDF kandi wuzuze imyanya y'impapuro isanzwe.

case-convert.name: Guhindura inyuguti nkuru/ntoya
case-convert.desc: Hindura inyandiko ube INYUGUTI NKURU, inyuguti ntoya, Umutwe Nk'Uyu, Interuro nk'iyi, camelCase, snake_case n'ibindi.

fancy-text.name: Gukora inyuguti z'ubwiza
fancy-text.desc: Hindura inyandiko isanzwe ibe inyuguti zirenga 30 z'ubwiza ku Instagram, TikTok, Facebook bios n'amazina y'imikino. Kopora ukanze rimwe.

text-to-speech.name: Inyandiko ihinduke ijwi
text-to-speech.desc: Soma inyandiko mu ijwi riranguruye ukoresheje amajwi y'igikoresho cyawe. Hitamo ijwi, umuvuduko n'ubugari. Ishyigikira indimi nyinshi.

speech-to-text.name: Ijwi rihinduke inyandiko
speech-to-text.desc: Andika uvuga: vuga mu mikoro maze ubone inyandiko igaragara ako kanya, hanyuma uyikopore cyangwa uyikure.

scientific-calc.name: Kalkulatrisi y'ubumenyi
scientific-calc.desc: Kalkulatrisi yo kuri interineti ifite trigonometrie, logarithmes, imbaraga, imizi, factorial, dogere/radians, ububiko n'amateka.

percentage.name: Kubara ijanisha
percentage.desc: Shaka X% bya Y, X ni ijanisha ringahe rya Y, impinduka y'ijanisha n'igiciro cy'igabanywa, hamwe n'amategeko ahoro intambwe ku yindi.

unit-convert.name: Guhindura ibipimo
unit-convert.desc: Hindura uburebure, ibiro, ubushyuhe, ubuso, ingano, umuvuduko, igihe, amakuru, igitutu n'ingufu.

age-calc.name: Kubara imyaka
age-calc.desc: Bara imyaka nyayo mu myaka, amezi n'iminsi, iminsi yose wabayeho, isabukuru itaha n'ikimenyetso cy'inyenyeri.

date-calc.name: Kubara amatariki
date-calc.desc: Bara iminsi hagati y'amatariki abiri, ongeraho cyangwa ukureho iminsi, ibyumweru, amezi n'imyaka, urebe n'umunsi w'icyumweru.

gpa.name: Kubara GPA
gpa.desc: Bara GPA y'igihembwe n'iy'ihuriro hakurikijwe amanota y'amasomo ku gipimo cya 4.0 hamwe n'inyuguti z'amanota.

due-date.name: Kubara itariki yo kubyara
due-date.desc: Teganya itariki yo kubyara n'icyumweru cy'inda uhereye ku mihango ya nyuma, itariki yo gusama cyangwa echographie, hamwe n'ibihe by'ingenzi.

spin-wheel.name: Zungurutsa uruziga
spin-wheel.desc: Kora uruziga rufite amazina cyangwa ibihembo ibyo ari byo byose, zungurutsa mu buryo bunyuranyije n'uko bikwiye, kuraho abatsinze, uburyo bwa ecran yose.

random-number.name: Gukora imibare itunguranye
random-number.desc: Kora imibare itunguranye mu rugero urwo ari rwo rwose, myinshi icyarimwe, ifite cyangwa idafite ibisubiramo, ku bufindo no ku mikino.

typing-test.name: Isuzuma ry'umuvuduko wo kwandika
typing-test.desc: Pima umuvuduko wawe wo kwandika (WPM) n'ukuri mu masegonda 30 kugeza ku minota 5.

cps-test.name: Isuzuma rya CPS (umuvuduko wo gukanda)
cps-test.desc: Bara inshuro ukanda ku isegonda mu masegonda 1 kugeza kuri 60, ubike amanota yawe meza, usuzume na spacebar n'gukoraho.

webcam-test.name: Isuzuma rya kamera
webcam-test.desc: Reba niba kamera yawe ikora, urebe ubwiza n'umuvuduko w'amashusho, uhindure kamera kandi ufate ifoto y'igerageza.

screen-recorder.name: Kwandika ecran
screen-recorder.desc: Andika ecran yawe, idirishya cyangwa tab hamwe n'amajwi ya sisitemu na mikoro, nta kwinstalla.

video-compress.name: Gufunga videwo
video-compress.desc: Gabanya amadosiye ya MP4, MOV na WebM yo koherezwa mu butumwa, kuri email no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Hitamo ubwiza n'ubuziranenge.

video-to-mp3.name: Videwo ihinduke MP3
video-to-mp3.desc: Kuramo amajwi mu mavidewo ya MP4, MOV na WebM nka MP3, hitamo ubuziranenge kandi ukate igice ukeneye.

guitar-tuner.name: Guhindura gitari
guitar-tuner.desc: Hindura gitari, ukulele na bass ukoresheje mikoro yawe: inoti, itandukaniro rya cents n'urushinge, hamwe n'amajwi y'ibanze.

password-gen.name: Gukora ijambobanga
password-gen.desc: Kora amajambobanga akomeye atunguranye cyangwa interuro zibukwa, hitamo uburebure n'inyuguti, ugenzure imbaraga.

signature.name: Gukora umukono
signature.desc: Shushanya umukono wawe n'imbeba cyangwa urutoki, cyangwa uwandike mu nyuguti z'intoki; kura PNG itagaragara.

logo-maker.name: Gukora ikirango
logo-maker.desc: Kora ikirango uhereye ku kimenyetso, izina ry'ikirango n'intero; hitamo inyuguti, amabara n'imiterere, ukure SVG cyangwa PNG.

notepad.name: Ikayi yo kuri interineti
notepad.desc: Inyandiko zihuse zibikwa zonyine muri browser yawe: inyandiko nyinshi, gushakisha, kubara amagambo no gukura TXT.

excel-word-fill.name: Uzuza Word uvanye muri Excel
excel-word-fill.desc: Fata ibikubiye muri dosiye ya Excel ubishyire mu bimenyetso bya dosiye ya Word, imitwe ifite nomero igaragara mu ibara ritukura.

excel-cell-merge.name: Huza udusanduku twa Excel two mu mpapuro / amadosiye menshi
excel-cell-merge.desc: Huza agasanduku kamwe (A1, B2...) ko mu mpapuro cyangwa amadosiye ya Excel menshi mu kamwe, ukamenyeshwa iby'udusanduku dufite amakuru mu isoko rirenze rimwe.

excel-row-concat.name: Shyira hejuru y'ikindi imirongo ya Excel yo mu mpapuro / amadosiye menshi
excel-row-concat.desc: Shyira impapuro cyangwa amadosiye ya Excel menshi hejuru y'ayandi mu mbonerahamwe imwe ndende. Umutwe ubikwa rimwe, imirongo irimo ubusa igasibwa.

excel-formula-merge.name: Huza amakuru ya Excel ukoresheje formula
excel-formula-merge.desc: Huza impapuro cyangwa amadosiye ya Excel menshi ukoresheje formula kuri buri gasanduku (SUM, IF, CONCAT, UNIQUE...), imikorere ishyizwe mu yindi, na formula zibitswe wakongera gukoresha.

sudoku-9x9.name: Sudoku 9x9
sudoku-9x9.desc: Kina Sudoku 9x9 kuri interineti mu nzego 10 uhereye ku koroshye ukageza ku kugora, hamwe n'inyandiko, inama no kugenzura amakosa.

sudoku-16x16.name: Sudoku 16x16
sudoku-16x16.desc: Sudoku nini 16x16 ikoresha 1-9 na A-G, inzego 10 uhereye ku koroshye ukageza ku kugora, hamwe n'inyandiko n'inama.

chess.name: Chess
chess.desc: Kina chess na mudasobwa ku nzego 10 cyangwa kuri interineti: tumira inshuti ukoresheje ihuza cyangwa ukine n'umuntu mushya. Harimo castling, en passant no kuzamurwa.

xiangqi.name: Xiangqi (chess y'Abashinwa)
xiangqi.desc: Kina Xiangqi na mudasobwa ku nzego 10 cyangwa kuri interineti: tumira inshuti ukoresheje ihuza cyangwa ukine n'umuntu mushya. Amategeko yuzuye: ukuguru kw'ifarashi, ijisho ry'inzovu, gusimbuka kw'igisasu n'abajenerali batemerewe kubonana.

go-game.name: Go
go-game.desc: Kina Go na mudasobwa ku nzego 10 cyangwa kuri interineti ku bibaho bya 9x9, 13x13 na 19x19 n'inshuti cyangwa uwo muhangana mushya. Kubara byikora ku iherezo.

memory-shapes.name: Kwibuka Ishusho n'Ibara
memory-shapes.desc: Tile zifite amashusho n'amabara ziragaragazwa amasegonda 5, hanyuma zigahishwa; wibuke uhitemo tile ikwiye, inzego 10 uhereye ku koroshye ukageza ku kugora.

web-desktop.name: Desktop yo kuri interineti
web-desktop.desc: Desktop ya mudasobwa muri mushakisha yawe: umuyobozi w'amadosiye, Notepad, umureba w'amafoto na PDF, imashini ibara, kalendari n'imyanda. Amadosiye abikwa muri Google Drive yawe.

co-up.name: Xiangqi ihishe (Cờ úp)
co-up.desc: Kina Xiangqi ihishe yo muri Vietnam: ibice bitangira byubitse bigahindurwa nyuma y'igikorwa cya mbere. Na mudasobwa ku nzego 10 cyangwa kuri interineti n'inshuti n'abo muhanganye bashya.

bg-remove.drop.title: Hitamo ishusho cyangwa uyishyire hano
bg-remove.drop.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Bikora neza ku mafoto y'ibicuruzwa afite inyuma y'umweru cyangwa y'ibara rimwe. Amashusho atunganyirizwa ku gikoresho cyawe.
bg-remove.tol.label: Ubushishozi
bg-remove.contiguous: Kuraho gusa inyuma ihuye n'impande (reka utuntu tw'ibara rimwe tuba mu kintu)
bg-remove.note.autobg: Ibara ry'inyuma rimenyekanira ku mpande. Niba atari ryo, kanda ahari inyuma ku ishusho y'ibanze kugira ngo uryihitiremo.
bg-remove.feather.label: Koroshya impande
bg-remove.stage.resultHint: Igisubizo kigaragara ako kanya uhisemo ishusho.

bg-remove.ai.mPortraitD: yihuse, icyitegererezo cyoroheje cya hafi MB 25, cyiza ku mafoto y'indangamuntu n'amafoto y'umwirondoro

bg-remove.ai.err: Ntibishobotse gukoresha AI muri iyi browser. Gerageza Chrome cyangwa Edge nshya.

attendance.add.label: Ongeraho umunyeshuri
attendance.add.ph: Andika izina maze ukande Enter (rimwe kuri buri murongo igihe usomeka byinshi)
attendance.date.label: Itariki yo kuboneka
attendance.note: Kanda ku kazu k'imiterere kugira ngo uhindure: Uhari → Udahari → Watinze → Wasabye uruhushya. Inkingi z'incamake zibara amateka yose. Injira na Google kugira ngo ubike muri Google Sheets.

attendance.empty: Nta banyeshuri baraboneka. Ongeraho amazina mu gasanduku ka hejuru (ushobora gushyiramo imirongo myinshi).

barcode.mw.label: Ubugari bw'umurongo
barcode.h.label: Uburebure bw'umurongo
barcode.hint.CODE128: Yemera inyuguti (zidafite utwitso), imibare n'ibimenyetso. Isanzwe ku bitumizwa, kohereza no mu bubiko.
barcode.hint.EAN13: Andika imibare 12; umubare wo kugenzura wongerwaho wikora. Barcode isanzwe y'ubucuruzi (ibicuruzwa bya UPC-A byo muri Amerika na Kanada bikora nka EAN-13 bifite 0 imbere).
barcode.hint.EAN8: Andika imibare 7; umubare wo kugenzura wongerwaho wikora. Ku bicuruzwa bito.
barcode.hint.UPCA: Andika imibare 11; umubare wo kugenzura wongerwaho wikora. Isanzwe ku bicuruzwa byo muri Amerika.
barcode.hint.CODE39: Yemera inyuguti nkuru (zidafite utwitso), imibare na - . $ / + %. Isanzwe ku bipapuro by'abakozi no ku bimenyetso by'ibikoresho.

bmi-bmr.actlvl.sedentary.hint: Akazi ko mu biro, kugenda gake, gukora siporo gake.
bmi-bmr.actlvl.veryActive.hint: Imirimo iremereye cyangwa imyitozo kabiri ku munsi.
bmi-bmr.note: BMI ikoresha imbibi z'Abanyaziya (zikwiye Abanyavietnam): isanzwe 18.5–22.9. BMR ikurikiza ikigereranyo cya Mifflin–St Jeor; TDEE ni ingufu zose zikoreshwa ku munsi. Imibare ni iy'ubuyobozi gusa kandi ntisimbura inama za muganga cyangwa umuhanga mu mirire.
bmi-bmr.prompt: Andika imyaka, uburebure n'ibiro byemewe kugira ngo ubone ibisubizo.
bmi-bmr.goals.title: Intego z'ingufu ukurikije icyo ushaka

calo-burn.note: Bibarwa hakurikijwe agaciro mpuzamahanga ka MET (metabolic equivalent): ingufu = MET × 3.5 × ibiro (kg) ÷ 200 × iminota. Ibisubizo ni iby'ubuyobozi kandi bihinduka bitewe n'imbaraga n'imiterere y'umuntu.
calo-burn.act.bike-mid: Gutwara igare ku muvuduko ugereranyije (19–22 km/h)

code-format.err.jsonHint: Koresha igikoresho cya Lint kugira ngo ubone aho biri.

code-check.okNote: Kode yemewe mu miterere no mu rutonde.

colors.css.title: Variable za CSS
colors.err.hex: Ibara rya HEX rigira inyuguti 3 cyangwa 6 za 0–9, a–f, urugero #0d6efd.
colors.err.twoHex: Andika amabara abiri ya HEX yemewe.
colors.v.aa: Ni byiza, yujuje AA ku nyandiko isanzwe
colors.v.large: Ni iy'inyandiko nini kandi yijimye gusa (18px+)

rsa-keys.status.none: Kora cyangwa wandukure imfunguzo hejuru. Urufunguzo rusange rugufasha gufunga; urwihariye rukagufasha gufungura.

rsa-keys.note: Byose bikorera muri browser yawe binyuze kuri Web Crypto kandi ntibyoherezwa ahandi. Kubera ko RSA ishobora gufunga amakuru magufi cyane gusa, igikoresho gikoresha gufunga kuvanze: gikora urufunguzo rwa AES rutunguranye gufunga inyandiko, hanyuma kigafunga urwo rufunguzo rwa AES na RSA — bityo inyandiko ndende iyo ari yo yose ishobora gufungwa. Uwakira akeneye urufunguzo rwihariye ruhuye kugira ngo afungure. Urufunguzo rusange (SPKI) rushobora gusangirwa; urwihariye (PKCS#8) rugomba kubikwa mu ibanga.

Igivietnamu kibarwa ku nyajwi nka Microsoft Word, bityo "cà phê" ni amagambo 2 — reba ibice by'amagambo 2 na 3 kugira ngo ubone interuro zifite ireme.

text-analysis.sample:
Ikawa y'amata ikonje ni ikinyobwa kimenyerewe ku bantu bo hirya no hino ku isi. Buri gitondo, miliyoni z'abantu batangira umunsi wabo n'ikirahuri cy'ikawa y'amata ikonje, iryoshye kandi iruhura.

Kugira ngo ukore ikawa y'amata ikonje nziza, ukenera ikawa yasekuwe vuba, amata na barafu nyinshi. Ikawa itekwa gahoro gahoro, igitonyanga ku kindi, mu minota nka itanu.

Ubu, ikawa y'amata ikonje ikundwa n'incuti zo mu bihugu byinshi kandi iboneka ku rutonde rw'ibinyobwa bya kafe zo ku isi hose.

typing-test.texts: Buri gitondo nzinduka kare nkajya kwiruka ku nkengero z'ikiyaga. Umwuka mwiza unyuzuza ubwonko kandi untegura umunsi mushya w'akazi. Hanyuma nsangira ifunguro n'umuryango wanjye, nkasoma impapuro nke z'igitabo maze nkatangira umunsi. Imigirire mito isubirwamo buri munsi ihinduka ibintu bikomeye uko igihe gihita.|U Rwanda ni igihugu cy'imisozi igihumbi, gifite ahantu nyaburanga henshi, uhereye ku birunga bya Musanze ukagera ku Kiyaga cya Kivu. Abakerarugendo bashobora gusura Pariki y'Igihugu ya Nyungwe, kwishimira umuziki w'i Kigali cyangwa kugenda mu mihanda ikeye y'umujyi. Buri karere gafite umwihariko waryo.|Kwiga kwandika udahanze amaso ku mfunguzo ni ubumenyi bufite akamaro ku muntu wese ukoresha mudasobwa. Iyo umaze kubimenyera, ntiwongera kureba kuri clavier, umuvuduko wawe uriyongera kandi ukora amakosa make. Itoze iminota nka cumi n'itanu buri munsi, banza wite ku kuri hanyuma wongere umuvuduko buhoro buhoro.
